label: Morning Brief
timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Reuters was read through a Lufkin Daily News republication.

driver.text: Per Reuters, at 7:07 AM ET Dow E-minis were down 0.94%, S&P 500 E-minis down 0.19% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis up 0.13%; the Nasdaq-100 closed Monday more than 10% below its record close, confirming a correction. Apple fell 3.9% premarket after warning that rising memory chip costs will pressure its holiday-quarter gross margin. Palantir fell 7.7% despite beating third-quarter expectations and forecasting fourth-quarter revenue above estimates. Nvidia rose 1.4% after four straight losing sessions. Crude rose after an Iranian official said a deal to end the war was far off. U.S. midterm elections are today.
